theorem: For fixed balanced involution X, every Hermitian involution anticommuting with X has the form Z(U) with U unitary. Projecting an arbitrary Hermitian target Z0 first to its X-odd block reduces nearest Clifford-factor recovery to the unitary Procrustes problem min_U ||U-C||_F. If C is invertible, its polar unitary U=C(C^*C)^(-1/2) is the unique global minimizer. This proves the higher-dimensional fixed-X theorem for every n and recovers the qubit result at n=1.
